Name: Soft Pink Weapons
Author: maeissimming
Description:
This is a simple weapon recolor in soft pinks that are meant to add a dash of pink without being overwhelming to the cozy vibe of the game.

This mod goes along with my other mod, Soft Pink Tools, which you can download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9073]here[/url]. (https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9073)

[list]
[*] Anything wooden is still wooden.﻿
[*] ﻿Base tools keep their original wood color and have soft pink metal.
[*] ﻿Copper tools are pink toned copper metal.
[*] ﻿Gold tools are rose gold metal.
[*] ﻿Iron tools keep their original wood color and gold stripe and have soft pink metal.
[*] ﻿Iridium tools are a brighter pink.
[*] Dark metals are now dark rose gold.
[*] Bone weapons are now warm toned to match the ossified blade.
[*] Anything that was blue is now cool toned med. bright pink.
[/list]
